reviews.text: Had an amazing experience at Local Public Eatery!! I was served by Meklit who was very nice and went through the menu with us , since it was my and I’s first time there. After dinner Qam came by and gave us a desert on the house which was absolutely delicious.  Strongly recommend this place. Great food and good vibes!!!

Celebrated my birthday here and reserved the patio for my party of ~40ppl. We had such a great time! Special thanks to Ben, Vico, and Sophie for taking care of us and accommodating all of our requests. The food and drinks were delicious (especially the steak and margaritas) and all came with good timing. My group was able to have separate bills and the team did a great job at keeping everything organized. Lovely team to communicate and plan with beforehand (shoutout Nicky!), the night couldn't have gone any better!!

We had a great experience. Daniel was our server and he was incredibly attentive, friendly and accommodating of us with our toddler at the table. Highly recommend asking for him !

Me and my bestie came to local to watch a fifa match, got placed upstairs on the rooftop bar, and the seats were perfect, right in front of the tv, food was great, our bartenders were so incredibly sweet, so shout out to Kaitlyn and Derka for making the experience so much better, very attentive, checking in on us every so often, overall we had such a great time and will be back!  🥹

My roommate and I came to Local Leaside to watch the FIFA World Cup and had the BEST time. We were up on the rooftop and the whole vibe was unreal. Huge shoutout to Kaitlyn S and Derka, their energy made the experience even better. They were so welcoming, fun, and really brought the atmosphere to life. Between the game, the crowd, and the service, everything was on point. Definitely one of those nights you don’t forget. Can’t wait to come back!

Always amazing service and especially Paige and Hazmile working on Canada in 40 plus degrees! Kudos to the chefs also! All together 5 star experience always!
Happy Canada Day The Local Staff!!!

Had the most amazing time at Local today, was in for the soccer game on a very busy patio and our server was Sydney. She handle the rush with ease and made sure our drinks were always full and she was very knowledgeable about the whole menu when we were deciding what to eat. Food and drinks were 10/10 as always. One of the best restaurant experiences I’ve ever had. Will definitely be back and will be requesting Sydney in the future!
First time at Local and it was great! Big shout out to Sydney for amazing service. She was attentive, asked us how our food was and refilled our drinks. Will definitely come back
